What Is DaySmart Vet?

DaySmart Vet is an easy-to-use cloud-based practice management solution that has served veterinary practices since 2011. Based in Ann Arbor, MI, DaySmart Vet focuses on making practice management straightforward and accessible, with a particular emphasis on client communication tools that help practices stay connected with pet owners.

The platform is cloud-based and targets small animal, general practice practices. We found DaySmart Vet to be a solid middle-ground option: it is more affordable and easier to learn than enterprise systems like ezyVet, while offering more client engagement features than bare-bones alternatives. Its two-way texting capability is a standout that many competitors lack or charge extra for.

DaySmart Vet starts at $120/mo with a per practice/month pricing model. A free trial is available, which we recommend taking advantage of to test the client communication features that are central to the platform's value proposition.

Key Features

We evaluated every major feature of DaySmart Vet. Here is a breakdown of what the platform offers.

Appointment scheduling

A clean scheduling interface with support for multiple providers, appointment types, and recurring bookings.

Two-way texting

Text directly with clients from within the platform. Clients can respond to appointment reminders, ask questions, and confirm visits.

Online booking

Let clients book their own appointments through an online portal, reducing phone call volume for the front desk.

Automated waitlists

When an appointment slot opens up, the system automatically notifies waitlisted clients to fill the gap.

Medical notes

Record clinical notes and treatment information in a straightforward, structured format.

Client communication

A centralized communication hub covering email, SMS, and in-app messaging with clients.

Inventory management

Track product stock levels, manage reorders, and monitor usage across the practice.

Payment processing

Accept payments in-clinic and online with integrated payment processing.

Who Should Look Elsewhere?

No software is perfect for every practice. Here are situations where DaySmart Vet may not be the best fit.

  • Practices that need cutting-edge AI features like automated SOAP note generation should consider Digitail or Onward Vet instead. DaySmart Vet's AI capabilities are limited compared to newer entrants.
  • Large specialty or emergency hospitals that require complex clinical workflows, referral management, and advanced EMR features will likely outgrow DaySmart Vet's capabilities.
  • Practices that depend on a wide range of third-party integrations should verify compatibility, as DaySmart Vet has fewer integrations than competitors like ezyVet or Digitail.

Final Verdict

DaySmart Vet is a strong choice for small to mid-size practices that prioritize client communication and want a system that is easy to learn and use daily. The two-way texting and automated waitlist features genuinely set it apart from competitors in its price range. At $120/mo, it offers fair value for practices that do not need enterprise-level clinical features.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is DaySmart Vet cloud-based?
Yes. DaySmart Vet is a cloud-based platform. You can access it from any device with a web browser and an internet connection. There is no server hardware to purchase or maintain.
Does DaySmart Vet offer a free trial?
Yes, DaySmart Vet offers a free trial so you can test the platform before committing. We recommend using the trial period to evaluate the features most important to your practice, such as scheduling, medical records, and any integrations you rely on.
What is DaySmart Vet's starting price?
DaySmart Vet starts at $120 per month. The pricing model is per practice/month, so your actual cost may vary depending on your practice size and configuration. Contact DaySmart Vet directly for an exact quote tailored to your needs.
Is DaySmart Vet good for small practices?
Yes, DaySmart Vet is well suited for small practices. Its small to mid-size practices focus means the platform was designed with smaller teams in mind. The interface is straightforward and does not require extensive training.
